description: Look before editing: what a document holds and how to address it. AI/EPS/SVG and PSD: layers and objects with ids, kinds, names, text, bounds, visibility, fonts. HWP/HWPX/DOCX: paragraphs, tables (number, rows, cols, merged cells), fields, {{placeholders}}. PDF: pages, sizes, text per page, scanned pages, fonts. Also XLSX/CSV sheets and images. Returns the format profile URI (ezpzfile://formats/<fmt>) with the edit ops and rules.

full.description: AI/EPS/SVG/PSD: list every object, not only layers, named objects, text and pictures
